name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.0.2.

Smarter payment reading: when a customer sends a photo, ASVA now checks whether it is really a payment (a UPI/bank/cheque proof) before doing anything. A product photo, a selfie or a bill no longer gets mistaken for a payment - so your reminders are never paused by accident and no wrong amount lands in your Payments tab. If it is a payment but the amount is not clear, ASVA shows it to you and asks you to confirm.

Reminders keep flowing: fixed a case where one undelivered message could hold up a shop's whole reminder queue, and the queue now clears old messages on its own even if the shop laptop was off for days.

Also includes the calmer updates from 2.0.1 and the privacy + assistant improvements from 2.0.
